child_list.content: The fox and the crow
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
A crow stood in a tree. The crow had a big piece of meat in her mouth. At this time, a fox came. He saw the meat in the crow’s mouth and wanted to eat it. He said, “What a beautiful bird! What beautiful eyes! What beautiful feathers! Does she have a beautiful

voice? I don’t know.” The crow was very happy and ready to sing. She opened her mouth and sang “Caw, caw!” The big piece of meat fell to the ground. The fox picked up the meat and ate it happily.

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 狐狸和乌鸦
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 一只乌鸦站在树上。乌鸦嘴里叼着一大块肉。这时，来了一只狐狸。他看到乌鸦嘴里的肉，想要吃掉它。他说：“多漂亮的鸟啊！多美的眼睛啊！多么漂亮的羽毛啊！不知道她是不是有一副美丽的嗓音呢？” 乌鸦很高兴，准备唱歌。她张开嘴，唱着“呱，呱！”那一大块肉掉在了地上。狐狸捡起肉，高兴地吃了起来。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
